claim: Patchline specifies a counterbalanced human study that measures reviewer time on migration pull requests with and without Patchline findings, so a claimed productivity benefit rests on a valid within-subjects design rather than an anecdote. The worker validates that every participant completed both the with-findings and without-findings conditions (a balanced within-subjects design), computes the per-participant time delta, and reports the mean reduction. The gate proves the protocol is balanced, the with-findings condition is meaningfully faster on average, and that a protocol in which a participant skipped a condition is rejected as unbalanced.
